latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of jogg-ai-image-to-video.
- Upload JPG, PNG, WEBP, or HEIC images (up to 200MB) and convert them to short animated 1080p MP4 video clips with a simple prompt.
- Automatic connection to backend and session management with free 7-day token (100 credits).
- Exports, credit checks, upload, and editing all routed via API; user interaction streamlined for fast video creation.
- Clear error handling and session state updates for reliability and clarity.
- Designed for marketers and creators needing quick, high-quality video content from static photos.
